name: superskills
description: Superskills marketplace — the superskills plugin (coding skills), superskills-design (the design skills) and superskills-marketing (the marketing skills), installable directly from this repo.

plugins.name: superskills
plugins.description: Coding skills with a Google/Meta-quality workflow (TDD, DRY, SOLID) — the coding pack is the default; design, marketing, media and gstack ship as separate plugins or opt-in via ./setup --packs.

plugins.name: superskills-design
plugins.description: The design skills (UX, interface design, typography, frontend engineering, SwiftUI, Vercel) as a separate plugin — install alongside superskills.

plugins.name: superskills-marketing
plugins.description: The marketing skills (SEO, content, pages, ads, channels, strategies) as a separate plugin — install alongside superskills.
